arStrings.szText: (chuckles) Magnificent! I dared not even hope the ritual would be so effective!
Effective?! We summoned demons into our very workshop! And then our friend here became a butcher demon! This is all wildly dangerous, we must not proceed!
Sheer nonsense! The transformation was perfectly controlled. The warding spell seems to remain in effect even now. Somehow it must have been amplified as well.
You think that was control? That wasn't a transformation ritual! We don't even know why this happened!
But we do know why it stopped! Because I stopped it. I was always in complete control of the situation.
Arrogant, then softer and more understanding.
There's no need to overreact. We simply need to study these results. In the meantime, I think our friend here can help prepare for our next steps.
Arrogant, then softer and more understanding.
Seek out more of these shrines. They've started appearing during Helltides. Once the shrine is activated, bring me blood from the summoned demons.
